{{Infobox map |name=Zerg Sector |year=2022 |image=Zerg-mini.jpg |creator={{player|alice|flag=se}} |gametype=1on1 |size=small |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/base/zerg.bsp |loc=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/202752389139136512/965353476655833098/zerg.loc }} '''Zerg''' is a smaller sized map with 2 YA and being sort of low on [[Lightning Gun]] ammounition. The map has 3 levels and is built for smooth movement across the areas with plenty of ambush corners and spam angles. Design is unified in a darker styled texturing with pink or lilac details, related to the Zerg aesthetic of the Starcraft universe. Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}} * The map has a brighter texture option if one find original textures too dark:
